items.q: What does an amalgam separator do?
items.a: It separates amalgam particles from aspiration systems, preventing their release into the environment and ensuring the safe collection of waste.
Vertical installation is recommended. Thanks to standard connection points, it can be integrated quickly and easily into the existing vacuum line.

items.q: Which systems is it compatible with?
items.a: It is compatible with all dental vacuum systems and central vacuum lines. It features standard connection dimensions.
Stainless steel provides superior corrosion resistance, long service life and is ideal for hygienic use.
The external surface can be wiped with a damp cloth. The internal section should be checked periodically and, when necessary, easily cleaned thanks to its removable design.
